scope: Configurable storage directory for audio subtitle records
notes: The native folder-picker dialog itself was not automated; choosing is handled by dialog.showOpenDialog and the persisted path/write/reset path was verified via the same IPC/settings flow.
The current session keeps the directory chosen at its start; changing the path while audio is active applies to the next audio session.
Long paths are ellipsized in the settings row with the full path in the tooltip.
